dedupeText: horror soundtrack cover art style horror slasher 80s aesthetic airbrushed dramatic lighting claws red and black cinematic foreshortened hand as the primary focal point high contrast between metallic highlights and dark shadows atmospheric depth created by layered smoke and fire colors diagonal composition leading from the top left face to the bottom right text combine a central menacing object with sharp highlights a fiery atmospheric background and bold angled typography for a classic horror aesthetic

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast horror aesthetic featuring a central menacing hand with sharp metallic extensions reaching toward the viewer against a smoky, fiery background.
triggerTerms: fiery red and black smoke background

recipe.visualDefinition: A dramatic, illustrative style characterized by a central, foreshortened hand with long metallic blades, set against a swirling, atmospheric background of deep reds, oranges, and blacks, with a secondary ghostly face in the upper corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreshortened hand as the primary focal point
High contrast between metallic highlights and dark shadows
Atmospheric depth created by layered smoke and fire colors
Diagonal composition leading from the top-left face to the bottom-right text
coreInvariants: Fiery red and orange atmospheric glow
Heavy use of airbrushed gradients for smoke effects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large, central hand dominates the middle ground, reaching forward; a smaller, ghostly face occupies the top-left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The metallic blades of the hand, which catch the most light and lead the eye downward.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face in the top left, follows the arm down to the hand, and terminates at the bright text in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense and atmospheric, filled with dark smoke and red light rather than empty space.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep red and orange (background glow and atmosphere)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and dark charcoal (shadows and silhouettes)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white and silver (metallic highlights on blades)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds, with extreme value contrast between the bright highlights and deep shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Neutral blacks and greys for depth

letterConstructionRules: Blocky, thick strokes for the main title
High-contrast serifs for the secondary text
Tilted or angled placement for dynamic effect

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the upper atmospheric area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy block sans-serif for impact paired with a classic high-contrast serif for information.
graphicDevices: Color-coded hierarchy (red for title, white for info)

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed blocky feel of the main title.
Matches the high-contrast serif style of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an airbrushed horror illustration featuring a foreshortened hand with long metallic blades reaching forward. The background should be a swirling mix of deep red and orange smoke with a ghostly, scarred face in the top left corner and a dark, silhouetted landscape at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a heavy, condensed red sans-serif font at a 15-degree angle in the bottom right. Add secondary text in a white, high-contrast serif font in the top right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the hand the primary focal point?
Are the metallic blades sharp and highlighted?
Is the color palette dominated by red, orange, and black?
Is the main title angled and bold?

adjustableVariables: Length and sharpness of the blades
Angle of the main title text
mustRedesign: Do not include existing movie logos
Ensure the text is not a direct copy of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Check for metallic sheen on the blades
Ensure the text hierarchy is clear
Confirm the foreshortening of the hand is effective
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central menacing object with sharp highlights, a fiery atmospheric background, and bold, angled typography for a classic horror aesthetic.
